bug: Period, Non-sports and Show more buttons drew a 1px border the original does not draw, and th cells and the theme button had the wrong border colour. The original's stylesheet carries site-wide element rules (button{border:none}, th,td{border:none}, button:hover,a:hover{background:transparent!important}, table{table-layout:fixed}) that src/index.css does not have. Measured on kalshi_d: 17 of 18 style probes differed (style 0.9444), e.g. button borderTopWidth 0px -> 1px, w 49 -> 51, h 28 -> 30, th borderTopColor rgb(237, 237, 237) -> rgb(46, 46, 46); pixel 0.0011 on desktop and 0.1062 on mobile.
caught_by: parity style probe and pixel diff on kalshi_d and kalshi_m (evals/out/diff/kalshi_d.style.diff)
fix: Wrote the missing element rules in app/src/pages/kalshi-leaderboard/site-base.css, imported by both pages. Style 0 and pixel 0 on the next run. The rules are site-wide and belong in src/index.css; they sit in the page folder until merged.

bug: Scenarios that click a period or Non-sports were observed before the new request finished, because the harness waits for network idle only once per page. kb_kalshi_period_7d_d scored dom 0.0726 with 771 original lines against 60 replica lines (replica still on Loading), and kb_kalshi_period_1m_d compared two loading states (59/60 lines) and so checked no rows at all. kb_kalshi_profile_link caught the original in mid navigation, with the leaderboard still in the DOM under display: none !important (773 lines).
caught_by: parity DOM diff line counts on the first run of the kb_ scenarios
fix: Each click that starts a request is followed by a hover on thead th, which waits until the table is rendered again; the two navigation scenarios wait 2500 ms. On the next run all period and filter scenarios compared 771 to 773 lines on both sides.

bug: The chart's SVG structure differs from the original: battle_d scored dom 0.8595 with 31 differing lines of 118/121. The installed recharts 3.10.1 names its layers (g.recharts-zIndex-layer_N), wraps each line path in g.recharts-layer.recharts-shape and drops the tooltip's transition: transform 400ms under reduced motion. The original bundle is recharts 3.7.0 (it contains rangeMin/rangeMax, new in 3.7.0, and handleKeyDown, removed in 3.8.0; the layer class first appears in 3.8.0).
caught_by: parity DOM diff on battle_d, battle_m and kb_battle_tooltip (evals/out/diff/battle_d.dom.diff)
fix: Not fixed in the tree: the version is set in app/package.json, which this builder does not own. Checked on a separate dev server that aliases recharts to 3.7.0: the chart lines of the diff are gone and style and pixel stay 0. Proposed change: pin recharts to 3.7.0.
